name: Zynq
description: Connect Claude to Zynq to manage workplace resources through natural language. Check availability, reserve desks and meeting rooms, manage visitors, view upcoming bookings, and interact with your workplace environment without switching applications. Zynq combines workplace management, space utilization, visitor workflows, and resource reservations into a conversational experience.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zynq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zynq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://zynq.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zynq MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zynq provides these MCP tools: cancel_booking, create_booking, get_booking_suggestions, get_my_bookings, and list_floorplans.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zynq?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zynq in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Zynq requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zynq is developed by Zynq.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
